title: Employee
description: Target contract for a migrated employee record.

employeeId.title: Employee ID
employeeId.description: Unique workforce identifier. Treated as an opaque string so leading zeros and prefixes survive migration.

fullName.title: Full name
fullName.description: Employee's full display name as recorded by the client.

startDate.title: Start date
startDate.description: Date employment began, as a calendar date.

endDate.title: End date
endDate.description: Date employment ended. Null for current employees. Must not precede the start date.

department.title: Department
department.description: Organisational unit the employee belongs to.
